title: On the Use of Quantile Regression Forests for Sub-seasonal Rainfall Forecasting over India
description: Research code for calibrating GEFSv12 sub-seasonal Indian summer monsoon rainfall forecasts with Quantile Regression Forests and comparing them with Extended Logistic Regression.
